neighbours.label: the split-word piece ' ard' or ' Ard' at the start of a rarer word (ardor, ardently, ardillas, Ardagh), in any language; words where the tokenizer does not produce that piece stay quiet
fire: The young poet praised her with the ardor of a first love.
Critics admired the ardour of his early speeches on reform.
She argued ardently for a new library in the old town.
En el parque vimos dos ardillas sobre una rama alta.
The family moved from Limerick to Ardagh when the farm failed.
Our train passed the Ardennes hills just after sunrise.
We spent a week cycling along the rivers of the Ardèche in June.
Era un defensor ardiente de la causa de los obreros.
quiet: The young poet praised her with the warmth of a first love.
Critics admired the courage of his early speeches on reform.
She argued loudly for a new library in the old town.
En el parque vimos dos palomas sobre una rama alta.
The family moved from Limerick to Galway when the farm failed.
Our train passed the Scottish hills just after sunrise.
We spent a week cycling along the rivers of the Loire in June.
Era un defensor valiente de la causa de los obreros.

short: the piece ' ard' / ' Ard' in split words
notes: Card: ' Ard' x8, ' ard' x5, 'rd', 'ARD', plus Ald|ous and Dol|om. Tokenizer checked. Probes: ardor 0.99, ardour 1.03, Ardmore 0.66, ardilla 0.82; other rare pieces also fire (Ald|ous 0.99, Dol|om|ites 0.86, ard|ua 0.49), so this label names part of the pole at most. Hard, thistles, bastard, Arduino as one token stayed under 0.03.
